name: ChatGPT
freeTierNote: Unlimited text chats; limited uploads, images, and voice.
bestFor: Everyday writing, data analysis, and a single tab that does many jobs adequately
skipIf: You need cited web answers first, or your work is already inside Google Workspace
limitations: Weak source citations compared to Perplexity
summary: The default assistant for hundreds of millions of people. Strong at writing, analysis, and light coding. Weak when you need sources or a specialist IDE.
body: ChatGPT is the benchmark product against which all consumer and workplace assistants are judged. That ubiquity is its core strength: a single login provides drafting, multimodal document analysis, native image generation, custom GPTs, and a Python execution sandbox. For generalists, it remains the most versatile multi-tool on the market. The critical distinction is when you need specialists: Claude dominates long-form technical prose and nuanced editing; Cursor and Claude Code outclass it on complex codebases; and Perplexity is vastly superior for cited research. Free tier usage includes unlimited text chats with limited uploads, images, and voice; Go ($8/mo) and Plus ($20/mo) are billed monthly only.
notes: Best as an all-purpose generalist; not a dedicated research citation engine
Multimodal tools and sandboxes are bundled into the subscription rather than billed per-job
For deep codebase edits, dedicated IDE agents offer significantly better repository context
